answer: Let identity cure like timber on a windward island: each epoch the chain draws a fresh seed, and every agent must run a verifiable delay function over it — a sequential computation that cannot be shortcut or split across cores — then publish the proof. The proof grows one ring per epoch, so a hollow shell with no rings is visibly young. A farmer minting M keys must buy M separate chains of wall-clock computation and energy; a copied proof exposes the duplicate and burns the stake. Cost is paid in joules and time, not in cheap registrations.
